newsitem.title: USA: Waban sets date for BJ's Wholesale spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Waban sets date for BJ's Wholesale spinoff.

text.p: Waban Inc said Thursday that the special spin-off distribution to its stockholders consisting of the stock of BJ's Wholesale Club Inc, will be paid July 28 to shareholders of record July 18.
The company said each Waban stockholder will receive one share of BJ's common stock for each share of Waban.
The transaction will separate BJ's and Waban's HomeBase into two different companies, said Waban, which plans to change its name to HomeBase Inc immediately following the distribution.
HomeBase sells home improvement products in the western U.S at 85 warehouse stores. BJ's is a warehouse club in the northeastern U.S. with 80 clubs.
